summary: The bad() entry point reads a line from the console and concatenates it unsanitized into the "Location" response header via response.addHeader. The fix URL-encodes the tainted value before inserting it into the header, which escapes CR/LF (and other control characters) as %0D/%0A while preserving legitimate query-parameter values.
